item.title: Mumbai Police arrest Kamaal R Khan for firing at residential building; actor's gun seized
item.description: Actor-producer Kamaal R Khan arrested after questioning in connection with an incident of firing in Oshiwara area of Mumbai. He will be produced before Court today, Police will take him into custody and carry out further investigation: Mumbai Police

item.title: Sensex, Nifty fall over 2% this week on FII outflows, global trade jitters
item.description: Broader indices posted stronger losses during the week, with the Nifty Midcap100 down 4.58 per cent while Nifty Smallcap100 declined 5.81 per cent. Bank Nifty ended the week with a firmly bearish technical tone after a decisive breakdown below the crucial 58,800 support.

item.title: Bank unions to go on nationwide strike on January 27 over five-day work week demand
item.description: The United Forum of Bank Unions has confirmed a nationwide strike by public sector bank employees on January 27, 2026, to demand a five-day work week. Despite conciliation meetings with the Indian Banks' Association, Ministry of Finance, and bank representatives, no resolution was reached. The strike, combined with January 25-26 holidays, will disrupt public sector banking services for three days.
